title: Configuration expansion at a work-cell index
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state binary Turing machine, let $\ell$ be a finite list of bit sources, let $T,t\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\tau$ be one of its work tapes, and let $w$ be a finite binary word. For every $r\in\mathbb{N}$ with $r<2T+1$, the configuration expansion at the index assigned to time $t$, tape $\tau$, and cell coordinate $r$ equals the work-cell expansion for $w,T,t,\tau,r$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state binary Turing machine
$\ell$ is a finite list of bit sources
